title: Pocket ledger + concierge notes — Portland AI Accelerator trip
content:
Purpose: quick pocket ledger + concierge notes for Portland AI Accelerator (Feb 25–27) — capture receipts, vendor contacts, oncall handoff, and currency/transport tips. Intended as a personal scratchpad to convert into formal expense report and short vendor debrief.

Summary notes (high-level):
- Flights: booked on company card (Amex ending 0421). Keep e-ticket + screenshot of final itinerary.
- Hotel: Hotel Alder (group rate). Ask front desk for itemized folio if incidentals charged.
- Per diem: use company per-diem caps (US domestic): $76/day for Portland. Keep meal split notes for multi-person meals.
- Local vendors: AV vendor is "Cascade AV" — primary: Luis M. (cell +1 503-555-0198). Confirm cable lengths (15ft) and breakout for HDMI->USB-C adapters.
- Taxi/ride: use Uber for late-night returns; capture receipts and include trip IDs. Keep cash for short downtown runs (small vendors sometimes cash-only).

Pocket ledger (raw receipts capture) — quick table to paste into Concur later:
Date | Amount | Cur | Category | Receipt? | Who paid | Notes
2025-02-24 | 14.50 | USD | Taxi | yes (photo) | Emily (personal) | PDX -> downtown (tip incl)
2025-02-25 | 28.00 | USD | Lunch | yes (photo) | Team card | Team lunch w/ speakers (split 3 ways)
2025-02-25 | 12.99 | USD | SIM card | yes (paper) | Emily (personal) | Local SIM (T-Mobile tourist)
2025-02-26 | 110.00 | USD | AV technician | yes (invoice) | Company card | Deposit for extra technician (Cascade AV)
2025-02-27 | 9.25 | USD | Coffee | yes (photo) | Emily (personal) | prep meeting

Receipt capture workflow (notes to self):
- Immediately snap 2 photos: full receipt + zoom on merchant/date/amount. Rename photos: pdx-YYYYMMDD-merchant-amt.jpg. Upload to shared drive under travel-expenses/pdx-2025/ by EOD.
- For company-card charges: paste card auth email and Amex reference into the expense item.
- For cash reimbursements: must have handwritten note with names + reason if over $25.

Currency + SIM notes:
- Portland is USD. No currency exchange needed.
- SIM: T-Mobile tourist SIM recommended (bought at airport kiosk). Keep packaging for IMEI if needed. Data plan: 3GB short term is fine for hotspot/Slack.

Vendor contacts (short list):
- Cascade AV — Luis Morales — +1 503-555-0198 — email: luis@cascadeav.co — invoice due net 15, request itemized breakout of labor vs equipment
- Conference caterer (Pacific Bites) — Maya Thompson — +1 503-555-0284 — confirm vegetarian options (vegan, gluten-free) and late coffee refill schedule
- Venue ops — The Commons Room — general PO inbox: ops@commonsroompdx.org — onsite contact: Dana (walkie channel 2)

Oncall & handoff notes (for SRE/hosted-api):
- I'll be on-call for morning coverage on Feb 26 (06:00–10:00 PT) — handover steps: verify queued jobs in router-queue v2, look for spikes in tail-latency (>1200ms).
- Slack escalation path: #infra-oncall -> if not reachable, page Marcus (SRE) with subject "Accelerator — perf alert".

Packing checklist (conference-focused):
- Laptop + charger + dongles (USB-C -> HDMI, Ethernet adapter)
- Local power strip + 3-outlet adapter (venues sometimes limited outlets)
- Presenter clicker + spare batteries
- Business cards (20) + one printed agenda for each speaker
- Portable battery pack + USB-C cable
- Small first-aid: band-aids, Advil.

Unresolved questions / TODOs:
- Confirm whether Cascade AV will invoice separately for travel days (Luis to confirm by Feb 20).
- Confirm vegetarian headcount by Feb 21 (Maya).
- Ask finance whether SIM purchase reimbursable under misc (ticket JIRA-TRVL-412).
- Double-check per-diem policy for mixed personal/company card charges. Ask HR/Finance.

Notes from pre-trip call (2/17):
- Venue floor plan change: keynote moved to north wall — need 2 extra gobo lights on stage left.
- Speaker wifi: register devices ahead of time (MAC addresses) to avoid captive portal.
- Parking: validated passes for 8 spots reserved under Redwood (event staff).

Post-trip debrief items (to convert to short internal doc):
- Quick wins: Cascade AV was responsive, reduced setup time by 40 mins.
- Pain points: coffee refill schedule slipped — consider catering SLA next time.
- Expense observations: many vendors only accept ACH (need earlier PO) — add wire/ACH timeline to site checklist.

Quick reimbursement checklist for myself: collect all receipt photos + rename -> drop into travel-expenses/pdx-2025/ -> fill Concur expense items -> attach photos + note 'Accelerator Portland' -> submit by 2025-03-05 (company 2-week window).

Random scratch (notes-to-self):
- If phone loses data in venue basement, default to wired tether from laptop + local SIM fallback.
- Consider bringing a collapsible umbrella (PDX weather suspicious).

End of scratchpad. Convert items above into formal expense report and vendor follow-up doc after trip.
notes: Informal scratchpad — intermediate step before filing official Concur report. Keep until 2025-03-10 then archive or move to shared drive if relevant for ops.
